item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00315","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C03","C24","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C03","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C03 is a closely contemporaneous resignation-acceptance letter for another Cabinet secretary and plausibly supplied both the structure and concrete language of the child. Both recount service in multiple high-responsibility roles, praise judgment concerning international and domestic affairs, characterize the official's contribution as benefiting the nation and President, and close with personal gratitude. C24 and C06 are strong secondary analogues in the same resignation-letter tradition, but C03 is materially closer in timing, office level, sequence, and phrasing.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Your service as Federal Loan Administrator, as Director of the Office of War Mobilization and Reconversion, and finally as Secretary of the Treasury","parent_excerpt":"Your services in positions of great responsibility have been as varied as they have been distinguished.","explanation":"Both organize the tribute around the departing secretary's progression through several major government responsibilities."},{"child_excerpt":"Your direction of the Government's fiscal affairs, your handling of many problems and responsibilities of international economic policy","parent_excerpt":"your vision and deep understanding of international as well as domestic affairs","explanation":"Both highlight mastery of interconnected domestic and international responsibilities."},{"child_excerpt":"merit not only my own personal appreciation ... but also the esteem of every citizen","parent_excerpt":"Your contribution to the national security places me and every other American in your debt.","explanation":"Both pair the President's personal gratitude with gratitude or esteem attributed to the entire country."},{"child_excerpt":"The judgment and understanding with which you have represented the United States ... have been other evidences of the honor and competence with which you filled a place of first importance in the public service.","parent_excerpt":"I thank you for your devotion and your wisdom and your skill.","explanation":"The child adapts C03's closing commendation of personal qualities and distinguished public service into a more expansive tribute."}]}
